title: Hedgehog wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hedgehog body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="32" ry="24" fill="#c97a3a"/>
  <!-- belly/face -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="20" ry="17" fill="#f5c98a"/>
  <!-- spines on back -->
  <g fill="#7a4b1e">
    <polygon points="22,60 14,45 30,52"/>
    <polygon points="26,48 20,30 36,42"/>
    <polygon points="36,40 34,20 46,36"/>
    <polygon points="48,36 50,16 60,34"/>
    <polygon points="60,38 66,18 72,38"/>
    <polygon points="70,46 80,30 80,50"/>
    <polygon points="76,56 88,48 82,66"/>
  </g>
  <!-- lighter spine highlights -->
  <g fill="#a8692e">
    <polygon points="24,58 18,46 30,52"/>
    <polygon points="30,46 26,32 38,42"/>
    <polygon points="40,38 40,24 48,36"/>
    <polygon points="50,34 52,20 60,34"/>
    <polygon points="62,36 66,22 71,38"/>
    <polygon points="72,46 78,34 79,50"/>
  </g>
  <!-- little ears -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="48" r="5" fill="#c97a3a"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="48" r="5" fill="#c97a3a"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#f5c98a"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="48" r="2.5" fill="#f5c98a"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#f0b070"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="63" r="3" fill="#6b3410"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M44 69 Q50 75 56 69" stroke="#8a4b20" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x="34" y="52" width="14" height="9" rx="3" fill="#1a1a2e" stroke="#3d3d5c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="52" y="52" width="14" height="9" rx="3" fill="#1a1a2e" stroke="#3d3d5c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x="47" y="55" width="6" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#3d3d5c"/>
  <!-- temple arms -->
  <rect x="30" y="54" width="5" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#3d3d5c"/>
  <rect x="65" y="54" width="5" height="2.5" rx="1" fill="#3d3d5c"/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x="36" y="54" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5b5b8a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <rect x="54" y="54" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5b5b8a" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#c97a3a"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#c97a3a"/>
  <!-- eye glints behind sunglasses (tiny bright dots) -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="56" r="1" fill="#f5e6b8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="56" r="1" fill="#f5e6b8" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
